name: nl-to-app-model
description: An agentic system that turns natural-language descriptions into validated, editable application models.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@nlam/shared && npm run build --workspace=@nlam/server && npm run build --workspace=@nlam/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@nlam/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@nlam/web"
scripts.verify: npm run check:charset && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
